blocks.label: Zone Investigation
blocks.instructions:
Active Sonar InvestigationFour contact zones appear on the bearing display.
  • Click a zone to ping it with active sonar
  • Active sonar guarantees identification — but each ping increases your detection risk
  • Some zones yield more intelligence value than others
  • Some zones carry higher risk penalties
  • Learn which zones are worth investigating
  • Maximize your total score over 100 trials
